crossRefs.note: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
He said: “Yahweh will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn…
The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
They will walk after Yahweh, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the…

translations.web: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
translations.bsb: Does a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey? Does a young lion growl in his den if he has caught nothing?
translations.kjv: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
translations.asv: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
